manifest.name: Village Fun Commands
installationSteps: Install Village Fun Commands in the wizard.
When online providers are enabled, import and approve Fetch Fun Content; keep it triggerless.
Choose command toggles and names, save, and restart StreamBridge.
Use the existing platform chat intakes; do not create separate Streamer.bot Command objects.
uninstallationSteps: Uninstalling preserves only bounded cooldown, recent-response, and hug-count state.

healthChecks.description: Confirms automatic fun commands, bounded provider relays, source-only replies, and offline fallbacks are available.
